description: S56 camera projection validation: left arm; 10 paired validation poses including side-yaw observations and a center transition, plus two HOME endpoints; radians.

camera_projection_check.status: Offline FK projection checked with saved camera calibration; not physically validated.
camera_projection_check.usage: Hold each pose still before inspecting/saving the overlay. Head angle and hold duration are configured outside this arm JSON.

side_yaw_check.head_yaw_sign: Positive yaw turns toward robot left.
side_yaw_check.result: CPV_LEFT at +30 deg, CPV_RIGHT at -30 deg, and CPV_CENTER at 0 deg project both wrist housings and complete fixed hand meshes inside a 30 px image margin. CPV_WIDE shows the left arm at +30 deg and the right arm at -30 deg; visibility of both arms in one image is not required.
side_yaw_check.limitations: Offline image-boundary projection only; does not test occlusion or physical camera accuracy.
side_yaw_check.visibility_requirement: At head yaw 0 deg a target may be outside the frame; the intended arm(s) must be visible at the corresponding +30 or -30 deg observation angle.

samples.name: CPV_WIDE
samples.viewing_note: Observe right arm at head yaw -30 deg and left arm at +30 deg; both wrist origins are outside the image at yaw 0 deg.

samples.name: CPV_LEFT
samples.viewing_note: Both arms biased toward robot left; observe with positive head yaw.

samples.name: CPV_CENTER
samples.viewing_note: Midpoint of CPV_LEFT and CPV_RIGHT; pause here with head yaw 0 deg before changing sides.

samples.name: CPV_RIGHT
samples.viewing_note: Exchange the CPV_LEFT arm poses and apply mirror_joint_signs; observe with negative head yaw.

offline_collision_check.geometry: complete original visual convex hulls with modeled fixed palms and fingers plus original URDF collision primitives; no wrist-only crop
offline_collision_check.hand_configuration: Full palm/finger mesh in the fixed hand shape represented by this URDF; finger articulation, grasped objects and extra attachments are not covered.
offline_collision_check.scope: all 12 synchronized left and right poses and every adjacent linear interpolation
offline_collision_check.assumptions: Arm path: head yaw 0 deg, pitch 22 deg; legs and waist at zero. Separate head-yaw scan holds both arms fixed at each waypoint.
offline_collision_check.excluded_pairs: Same link, parent-child and grandparent-child pairs; connected-joint assembly overlaps are not resolved by this check.
offline_collision_check.between_arms_closest_segment: CPV14 to CPV16, between left and right link7 hand geometry

head_yaw_scan.scope: hold both arms fixed at each pose independently; scan head yaw -30 to +30 deg inclusive at 1 deg intervals; not simultaneous arm and head motion

offline_collision_check.limitations: Offline discrete model checks only; continuous sweeps, simultaneous arbitrary arm/head movement, connected-joint geometry, tracking error, cables, fixtures, external obstacles and current-pose-to-T0 motion are not validated.
